item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This amuses me. By which, of course, I mean that it causes amusement within myself, defined as me and only me, and exactly zero things which are not me. The "Inapplicable Object Classes" was genius (and it's especially funny how many of those have actually been used for something). It might be funnier if SCP-Whatever was actually recontained as a result of its exposure. Oh, just imagine what would happen if SCP-4357-J (the Cooperative Demon) was exposed to this…

Personally, I would take out/tone back the Atlas Shrugged joke, just because summarizing it as "I Hate Poor People: The Long Version" is insulting a book that some people actually do like in what at least feels like a political way. I don't particularly like the book, and I agree that it suffers from the problem described, but given how you were able to do the same joke (much better, in my opinion) with War and Peace in a neutral way, I think you could change the joke or replace and the article would be improved. Maybe "Capitalism is good" or something. Or use another book. Or switch the pictures so it's not the first thing a reader sees. It's not a dealbreaker, and I'm still granting this an upvote, but starting the article with what looks like a potentially-political cheap shot at a controversial book took me out of the article for a second, and overall lessens my enjoyment. I just think it would be funnier (and get more votes) that way. Still upvoting.
